rules.text: Everything is square: cards, images, buttons and panels have 0 radius, no borders and no shadows.
Cards are flat grey fields (#EFF1F2, #E0E2E5) or Bosch blue #007BC0; photos bleed to the card edges.
Bosch red #ED0007 is reserved for the logo; interactive colour is blue #007BC0.
Titles and links end in a › chevron; headings are Bosch Sans bold, text regular — no other weights.
The supergraphic runs as a thin band across the top edge; it is never cropped into shapes.
Pictograms are Bosch line icons in black (white on dark), 80px, top-left in a grey tile, never in a coloured circle.
Key figures are set big and bold in one section colour (blue, teal, green or purple) with the label below in the same colour, or small and black under a pictogram in a grey tile.
People are shown in 16:9 colour photos with square corners; name bold, role regular, never in circles.
